origin.description: Pass the value on the left into the call on the right.

arguments.name: rhs
arguments.text: A function or a call that receives that value.

origin.details: stringr re-exports the magrittr pipe. It does not define another one.
origin.value: The result of the last step.

translation.description: Pass the value on the left into the call on the right.

arguments.name: rhs
arguments.text: A callable, or a (callable, args, kwargs) step. The piped value is the first argument unless DOT marks another one.

translation.details: stringr.pipe is magrittr.pipe. A callable step receives the current value. The pipe is not reimplemented here.
translation.value: The result of the last step.
translation.example:
from stringr.pipe import pipe

print(pipe(2, lambda value: value + 3, lambda value: value * 4))
